facts.fact: On 4 June 2026 the Ministry Delegate for Digital Transition and Administration Reform signed a memorandum with Orange Morocco on AI use cases in e-government, described as part of implementing the Digital Morocco 2030 strategy through the JAZARI Institutes programme.

systems.owner: Ministry Delegate for Digital Transition and Administration Reform

note: Class is left empty on the fact: the article does not describe Digital Morocco 2030's scope.
